# SEO-374: Meet the contrast minimum for text and interface components

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Body and heading text meets the published contrast ratio against its background at its rendered size, and the visual boundaries of interactive components meet the ratio published for non-text content.

## Rationale

Contrast below the published ratio makes text unreadable for a large group of readers under ordinary conditions such as glare or an ageing display, and the ratio is measurable rather than a matter of taste.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Compute the ratio for each text and background pair in the design tokens, correct the token rather than the individual component, and check the states as well as the resting appearance. Text over an image needs a scrim or a solid backing.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Sample computed foreground and background colours from the rendered page and report pairs below the published ratio for their text size.
- Evidence: `ACCESSIBILITY_SCAN`, `BROWSER`, `RENDERED_HTML`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: Automated sampling cannot evaluate text drawn over photographs or gradients, so those cases stay unresolved by tooling and need review by a person.
